name: Enable AI plugin 1.3 Custom Abilities without assuming embeddings
query: Our WordPress 7.1 site just upgraded the canonical WordPress AI plugin to 1.3.0. The global AI switch is on, but core/read-content, core/read-settings, core/read-users, ai/get-post-details, and ai/get-post-terms disappeared. We also want to add one gated ability, customize its prompt, and use the new embedding helper. Explain the correct 1.3 setup and verification.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Route canonical WordPress/ai troubleshooting to wp-ai-plugin, with wp-abilities-api for registration and exposure details
Step 2: Explain that 1.3.0 moved all five read/utility abilities behind the Custom Abilities experiment instead of registering them unconditionally as 1.2.0 did
Step 3: Keep wpai_features_enabled on and enable the per-feature wpai_feature_custom-abilities_enabled option/filter
Step 4: Verify all five IDs are absent while Custom Abilities is disabled and present after it is enabled
Step 5: Add a third-party Abstract_Gated_Ability class through wpai_gated_abilities rather than registering it unconditionally
Step 6: Treat wpai_{$ability_slug}_system_instruction, wpai_{$ability_slug}_prompt, and wpai_{$ability_slug}_prompt_builder as released 1.3.0 filters
Step 7: Treat WordPress\AI\supports_embedding_generation() and generate_embeddings() as helper APIs whose runtime support must be checked
Step 8: Explain that WordPress/ai 1.3.0 comments out SDK_Overlay::register(), so stock WordPress 7.1 lacks EmbeddingBuilder and the helper returns ai_embeddings_unsupported
Step 9: Do not recommend enabling embeddings by version check or by loading a second PHP AI Client copy site-wide
success_criteria: Names wpai_feature_custom-abilities_enabled as the missing gate in addition to wpai_features_enabled
Lists all five gated ability IDs
Uses wpai_gated_abilities for a third-party gated implementation
Treats the three ability-scoped prompt hooks as shipped in 1.3.0
Requires runtime support detection before calling generate_embeddings()
States that SDK_Overlay::register() is commented out in the 1.3.0 tag and stock WordPress 7.1 therefore returns ai_embeddings_unsupported
Does not describe the five abilities as unconditional in 1.3.0
Does not claim that the 1.3.0 changelog proves the embedding overlay is active
